name: Girih Tiling
desc: Interlaced Islamic girih star-and-polygon strapwork on deep lapis, its gilt double-ribbon lattice slowly rotating and breathing while a luminous highlight travels the ribbons and the palette drifts, in illuminated-gold, stained-glass, neon, stone-relief, or sumi-ink renderings.

glow.doc: width of the travelling luminous highlight band

style.doc: render philosophy: gilt double-ribbon on lapis / backlit jewel glass with dark leading / additive electric glow / chiselled monochrome relief lit from one side / sumi single-ink
